A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the media is a powerful tool to influence people's opinions and behaviors and it is essential for the communication and prevention of drug addictions.

it is necessary to improve the communication of prevention in the media, especially the communication of prevention programs, in order to achieve a better understanding of prevention and its role in the fight against drugs.
we have been able to identify the need of a public relations program in the field of prevention of addictions and the need of an evaluation system to measure the impact of these activities.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the media are an important ally in the fight against drug abuse, but that the way in which they cover the issue is often inadequate and that the way in wich institutions work with the media is not always effective.
